text:
Alex P.: Heads up — planning a canary for payments-service v2 today. Who's on deploy and available for smoke windows? target ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~45m. Need rollback owner.
Maya S.: I'm available 3pm–5pm PT. I'll own smoke for the 1% and 5% windows.
Ravi K.: I can be on-call for rollback. @Maya S. can you confirm cohort filters? geo and header-based?
Jordan L.: Cohorts: 1% global for initial, then 5% US+EU as second, 20% US only. Exclude internal/test accounts (cookie/header). I'll update router config.
Alex P.: ETA deploy start: 15:05 PT. Smoke checks: latency p50 < 200ms, error-rate < 0.5% for 5m after ramp. Rollback trigger: >1% error rate OR 2x latency vs baseline.
Maya S.: Ack. Smoke steps: run health + sample payloads. I'll post quick results. @deploy-bot please schedule the canary job.
deploy-bot: Deploy job scheduled: payments-service:v2 -> canary. job-id: job-89123. Start window: 15:05 PT.
Maya S.: smoke commands:
```
# smoke script (run locally in ci-smoke)
curl -s -X POST https://payments-api.prod/charge -d '{"amount":100,"currency":"USD"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN' | jq '.status'
```
Jordan L.: Router change ready: PR #512 merged. Config weights: 0.01 -> 0.05 -> 0.2. Will watch pod token buckets and cpu.
deploy-bot: Canary started (job-89123) at 1736579000 — 1% traffic routing applied.
Maya S.: Smoke @1736579060: sample run passed, p50=180ms, error=0.1% :thumbsup:
Alex P.: After 10m stable we ramp to 5%.
deploy-bot: Ramped to 5% at 1736579420 (job-89123).
Maya S.: 5% smoke: p50=210ms, error=0.6% — slightly over threshold. Investigating. @Ravi K. can you check backend queue depth and worker errors?
Ravi K.: Looking — write queue depth spike in us-east-1, a few worker OOMs. Initiating rollback to contain blast radius.
deploy-bot: Rollback applied for job-89123 -> traffic back to 1%.
Jordan L.: Rollback confirmed, router weight -> 0.01. Will push hotfix (tweak batch size) and reattempt a smaller ramp afterward.
Alex P.: Thanks team. Schedule a follow-up postmortem at 16:00 PT to decide reattempt timing and action items. Closing thread for now.
